configurePresets.name: windows-x64
configurePresets.description: The configuration release candidates are qualified with. Visual Studio 18 2026 targeting x64, warnings as errors. CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE is deliberately absent: this is a multi-config generator, so the configuration is selected at build and test time instead.

testPresets.name: windows-x64
testPresets.description: Every registered test. Release qualification runs this preset and nothing narrower: a hand-written selection previously omitted six of the nineteen gates, including the diagnostics, local storage and support-bundle gates, so regressions in them could not fail a candidate.
